title: Worthwhile excursion beyond Barcelona
text: Had a great experience touring Montserrat and Cave of St. Ignatius in Manresa. Joan was a great tour guide, provided knowledge when asked and provided time for reflection when appropriate. He even made lunch reservations when not required; felt like an extended member of the family.definitely recommend!
author: Culture63798456194

title: Montserrat with Joan
text:
Joan was very professional and took  care of us during our whole excursion.

From pickup to drop-off we had our needs met, and surpassed.

Montserrat was beautiful, and Manresaxwas inspiring.

It woukd be hard to go wrong with Joan and Montserrat!
author: V8538MDpeterg

title: The experience of San Ignacio de Loyola in Montserrat and Manresa.
text:
We sought this excursion with the aim of learning more about San Ignacio de Loyola. In our understanding, Montserrat and Manresa are known worldwide for what the Saint experienced in those places. While it is interesting what was conveyed to us about those places, the Saint was not the focus of the excursion and sometimes came up due to our questions. (The guide was well-informed about San Ignacio) 
We believe that the experience of the Saint can be highlighted more in those places. He is not a martyr saint or a child; he is a Saint who becomes one having everything, but not only that, he gave
author: O7016HCmanuelv

title: Meaningful Discoveries North of Barcelona
text: My guide at both Montserrat and Manresa, Joan, was very informative and inspiring. I would recommend the trip for anyone.
author: tomoU8978GS
